text:
Priyanka S: Hi everyone! First day and ran into two quick things: my Okta shows active but when I try to enroll a passkey it errors with 'Enrollment blocked: policy mismatch'. Also the 1Password invite I received points to pri.s@gmail.com (personal) instead of pri.s@redwood.dev. Who should I tag to fix both?

Jordan (People Ops): welcome Priyanka :tada: Sorry about the invite mixup  I'll revoke the personal one and send a new seat to pri.s@redwood.dev right away.

Avery (IT): welcome! For the passkey error, that usually means device-trust policy hasn't been applied to your OU yet or a stale session exists. Are you on a managed laptop?

Priyanka S: I'm on a company MacBook (enrolled in MDM). I did accept the Okta device trust prompt earlier but nothing changed.

Avery (IT): good detail. I'm pulling your Okta logs now. IT Support Bot: created ticket #INC-2277 "New hire Priyanka - passkey policy mismatch + 1Password email" assigned -> Avery (IT).

Sam (DevOps): fwiw, if the recruiter created the account with the personal email alias, some provisioned artifacts (shared Drive links, repo invites) could be tied to that alias and cause unexpected access failures later. Good to normalize now.

Jordan (People Ops): revoked personal 1Password invite and resent seat to pri.s@redwood.dev. You should get it in a minute; check Promotions/Spam if not.

Priyanka S: got the 1Password invite and set up MFA, thanks Jordan!

Avery (IT): I see a stale Okta session and policy assignment lag. I'm forcing a session refresh and reapplying the device-trust policy for your account. After I push this, try passkey enrollment in an incognito window.

Priyanka S: trying now... enrollment succeeded! device trust shows active and I can access internal docs. 

Sam (DevOps): great. For repos, ping me or Marc L with the repo slugs and we'll add you to the correct org teams.

Priyanka S: will do, thanks everyone for the quick help :smile: Appreciate the warm welcome!
